<script>
/* Progressive enhancement for the GilaClick services page. */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  function setup(root) {
    if (!root || root.dataset.gpReady === '1') return;
    root.dataset.gpReady = '1';
    root.setAttribute('dir', 'rtl');
    root.setAttribute('lang', 'fa');
    var inEditor = document.body.classList.contains('elementor-editor-active') || /[?&]elementor-preview=/.test(location.search);
    var nav = root.querySelector('.gp-primary-nav');
    var widget = root.querySelector('.gp-menu-toggle');
    var toggle = widget && widget.querySelector('a');
    var small = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)');
    if (!inEditor && nav && toggle) {
      root.classList.add('gp-js');
      toggle.setAttribute('role', 'button');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-controls', nav.id || 'gp-main-nav');
      function close(restoreFocus) {
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        if (small.matches) nav.hidden = true;
        if (restoreFocus) toggle.focus();
      }
      function sync() {
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        nav.hidden = small.matches;
      }
      sync();
      toggle.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!small.matches) return;
        var opening = nav.hidden;
        nav.hidden = !opening;
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(opening));
      });
      toggle.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
        if (event.key === ' ') { event.preventDefault(); toggle.click(); }
      });
      nav.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        if (event.target.closest('a') && small.matches) close(false);
      });
      document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        if (small.matches && !nav.hidden && !nav.contains(event.target) && !toggle.contains(event.target)) close(false);
      });
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
        if (event.key === 'Escape' && small.matches && !nav.hidden) close(true);
      });
      if (small.addEventListener) small.addEventListener('change', sync); else small.addListener(sync);
    }
    // Sticky section navigation: keep native anchor links as the no-JS fallback.
    var quick = root.querySelector('.gp-quickbar');
    var quickTrack = quick && quick.querySelector('.gp-quick-scroll');
    if (quick && quickTrack && !inEditor) {
      quick.setAttribute('aria-label', 'دسترسی سریع به بخش‌های خدمات');
      var links = Array.prototype.slice.call(quickTrack.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]'));
      var pairs = links.map(function (link) {
        var id = link.getAttribute('href').slice(1);
        return {link: link, section: id && document.getElementById(id)};
      }).filter(function (pair) { return !!pair.section; });
      var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      if (!reduced.matches) document.documentElement.classList.add('gp-smooth-scroll');
      if (reduced.addEventListener) {
        reduced.addEventListener('change', function () {
          document.documentElement.classList.toggle('gp-smooth-scroll', !reduced.matches);
        });
      }
      var scheduled = false;
      var active = null;
      var lastTop = -1;
      var lastScrollMargin = -1;
      function headerOffset() {
        // Only count bars actually fixed/stuck at the top, not normal-flow headers.
        var bars = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#wpadminbar, header, .site-header, .elementor-location-header, [data-gp-fixed-header]'));
        bars = bars.filter(function (bar) { return bar !== quick && !quick.contains(bar); });
        bars.sort(function (a, b) { return a.getBoundingClientRect().top - b.getBoundingClientRect().top; });
        var bottom = 0;
        bars.forEach(function (bar) {
          var style = window.getComputedStyle(bar);
          var box = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
          var pinned = style.position === 'fixed' || style.position === 'sticky' || (bar.id === 'wpadminbar' && style.position === 'absolute');
          if (pinned && style.visibility !== 'hidden' && style.display !== 'none' && box.height > 0 && box.top <= bottom + 2 && box.bottom > bottom) {
            bottom = box.bottom;
          }
        });
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.ceil(bottom), Math.floor(window.innerHeight / 2)));
      }
      function keepActiveVisible(link) {
        if (!link) return;
        var trackBox = quickTrack.getBoundingClientRect();
        var linkBox = link.getBoundingClientRect();
        var delta = linkBox.left < trackBox.left + 8 ? linkBox.left - trackBox.left - 8 :
          linkBox.right > trackBox.right - 8 ? linkBox.right - trackBox.right + 8 : 0;
        if (delta) quickTrack.scrollBy({left: delta, behavior: reduced.matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth'});
      }
      function updateQuick() {
        scheduled = false;
        var adminBar = document.getElementById('wpadminbar');
        var adminOffset = 0;
        if (adminBar) {
          var adminBox = adminBar.getBoundingClientRect();
          // WordPress uses a fixed desktop bar and a scroll-away mobile bar.
          adminOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(adminBox.height, adminBox.bottom));
          root.style.setProperty('--gp-admin-offset', adminOffset + 'px');
        }
        // If a theme keeps another header fixed above this page, stack our own
        // header beneath it before measuring the quick-navigation offset.
        var ownHeader = root.querySelector('.gp-header');
        var externalBars = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#wpadminbar, header, .site-header, .elementor-location-header, [data-gp-fixed-header]'));
        externalBars = externalBars.filter(function (bar) { return bar !== ownHeader && !(ownHeader && ownHeader.contains(bar)) && !root.contains(bar); });
        externalBars.sort(function (a, b) { return a.getBoundingClientRect().top - b.getBoundingClientRect().top; });
        var externalBottom = 0;
        externalBars.forEach(function (bar) {
          var style = window.getComputedStyle(bar);
          var box = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
          var pinned = style.position === 'fixed' || style.position === 'sticky' || (bar.id === 'wpadminbar' && style.position === 'absolute');
          if (pinned && style.visibility !== 'hidden' && style.display !== 'none' && box.height > 0 && box.top <= externalBottom + 2 && box.bottom > externalBottom) externalBottom = box.bottom;
        });
        root.style.setProperty('--gp-header-top', Math.max(adminOffset, Math.ceil(externalBottom)) + 'px');
        var top = headerOffset();
        var height = Math.ceil(quick.getBoundingClientRect().height);
        if (top !== lastTop) { root.style.setProperty('--gp-quick-top', top + 'px'); lastTop = top; }
        // WordPress may add scroll-padding to <html>; do not count it twice.
        // On small screens its absolute admin bar scrolls away before any
        // section target is reached, so exclude its currently visible height.
        var scrollPadding = parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).scrollPaddingTop) || 0;
        var disappearingAdmin = adminBar && window.getComputedStyle(adminBar).position === 'absolute' ? adminOffset : 0;
        var scrollMargin = Math.max(0, Math.round(top + height - scrollPadding - disappearingAdmin));
        if (scrollMargin !== lastScrollMargin) {
          root.style.setProperty('--gp-scroll-offset', scrollMargin + 'px');
          lastScrollMargin = scrollMargin;
        }
        var probe = top + height + 32;
        var current = null;
        pairs.forEach(function (pair) { if (pair.section.getBoundingClientRect().top <= probe) current = pair.link; });
        if (current !== active) {
          links.forEach(function (link) {
            if (link === current) link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'location');
            else link.removeAttribute('aria-current');
          });
          active = current;
          keepActiveVisible(active);
        }
      }
      function scheduleQuick() {
        if (!scheduled) { scheduled = true; window.requestAnimationFrame(updateQuick); }
      }
      window.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleQuick, {passive: true});
      window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleQuick, {passive: true});
      if ('ResizeObserver' in window) new ResizeObserver(scheduleQuick).observe(quick);
      links.forEach(function (link) { link.addEventListener('click', updateQuick); });
      updateQuick();
    }
    if (!inEditor && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      root.classList.add('gp-hero-live');
      var hero = root.querySelector('.gp-hero');
      if (hero && 'IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        var heroObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
          root.classList.toggle('gp-hero-paused', !entries[0].isIntersecting);
        }, {rootMargin: '100px 0px'});
        heroObserver.observe(hero);
      }
      // Lightweight scroll-linked section rails; only transforms are updated.
      var scenes = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.gp-scroll-scene'));
      var sceneScheduled = false;
      function updateScenes() {
        sceneScheduled = false;
        var viewHeight = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
        scenes.forEach(function (scene) {
          var box = scene.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (box.bottom < 0 || box.top > viewHeight) return;
          var progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (viewHeight - box.top) / (viewHeight + box.height)));
          scene.style.setProperty('--gp-scene-progress', progress.toFixed(3));
        });
      }
      function scheduleScenes() {
        if (!sceneScheduled) { sceneScheduled = true; window.requestAnimationFrame(updateScenes); }
      }
      window.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleScenes, {passive: true});
      window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleScenes, {passive: true});
      updateScenes();
    }
    // Elementor 4's classic accordion applies aria-selected to a role=button
    // and creates nested focus stops. Keep its native accordion behavior, but
    // move the button semantics to its existing keyboard-focusable title link.
    if (!inEditor && 'MutationObserver' in window) {
      root.querySelectorAll('.gp-faq .elementor-tab-title[role="button"]').forEach(function (title) {
        var button = title.querySelector('.elementor-accordion-title');
        var controls = title.getAttribute('aria-controls');
        if (!button || !controls) return;
        button.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        button.setAttribute('aria-controls', controls);
        function syncAccordion() {
          var expanded = title.getAttribute('aria-expanded');
          if (expanded !== null) button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', expanded);
          ['aria-expanded', 'aria-controls', 'aria-selected', 'role'].forEach(function (attr) {
            if (title.hasAttribute(attr)) title.removeAttribute(attr);
          });
          if (title.getAttribute('tabindex') !== '-1') title.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
          // Elementor's classic widget uses jQuery slide animations; finish only
          // this panel immediately when the visitor asks for reduced motion.
          if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches && window.jQuery) {
            var panel = document.getElementById(controls);
            if (panel) window.jQuery(panel).stop(true, true);
          }
        }
        var a11yObserver = new MutationObserver(syncAccordion);
        a11yObserver.observe(title, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['aria-expanded', 'aria-controls', 'aria-selected', 'role', 'tabindex']});
        syncAccordion();
      });
    }
    if (!inEditor && 'IntersectionObserver' in window && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      var nodes = root.querySelectorAll('.gp-reveal, .gp-card-reveal');
      if (nodes.length) {
        root.classList.add('gp-motion-ready');
        var delivered = false;
        var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
          delivered = true;
          entries.forEach(function (entry) {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('gp-in-view'); observer.unobserve(entry.target); }
          });
        }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -35px 0px', threshold: 0.05 });
        nodes.forEach(function (node) { observer.observe(node); });
        // If an observer never delivers at all, fail open; normal offscreen items
        // remain observable until they are actually reached, even on a slow visit.
        window.setTimeout(function () {
          if (!delivered) {
            nodes.forEach(function (node) { node.classList.add('gp-in-view'); });
            observer.disconnect();
          }
        }, 2500);
      }
    }
  }
  function init() { document.querySelectorAll('.gp-page').forEach(setup); }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init); else init();
}());

</script>
